scientific_question: Does risk-constrained selection increase label-defined evaluability on project-unseen images, and does P20 add useful benefit over exact Greedy20?

sources.alternative: Objects365-v2 train; external-source confirmation track, not COCO same-source replication

sampling.role_rule: hash rank 1..400 selection; 401..800 reference; 801..850 selection technical reserve; 851..900 reference technical reserve
sampling.allowed_reserve_use: in frozen rank order for download/decode/official-box/exact-or-near-duplicate failures only, before annotations/predictions
sampling.forbidden_reserve_use: no replacement for model disagreement, unknown labels, poor support or classifier results

required: all planned originals decoded and official dimensions/bounds checked
all bound paths SHA256 verified against historical registry and actual available historical original/crop content
all selection/reference/train/development exact and near duplicates excluded at original-image level
cross-class and cross-role duplicates excluded before any annotation
manifest and source archives/range-download checks frozen; no unresolved lineage/input failures
data_gate.near_duplicate_rule: Conservative full-original dHash64<=4 including horizontal mirror; target-crop pHash<=4 and frozen ViT cosine>=0.980 OR pHash<=8 and cosine>=0.995; exact SHA always excluded. Apply against accessible historical originals/crops and within the new pools; missing historical originals prevent certification.
data_gate.threshold_source: existing project acquisition and near-duplicate rules; no tuning using new outputs
data_gate.acquisition: Sequential package streaming/extraction of frozen target basenames; do not retain full new archives or duplicate range chunks. Preserve verified target files and acquisition provenance. This changes storage strategy, not target membership.

annotations.protocol: original native old/car schemas and templates; original independent-named-v2 fine schemas/prompts for horse/sheep/person/car
annotations.backend_symmetry: same task text, schema and evidence bytes for A/B; transport-only differences logged; no first-model answer sharing
annotations.native_evidence: original + marked original + feature crop, frozen ensure_views geometry
annotations.failure: retain raw responses and schema failures; formatting reminder only, no label remapping/adjudication or prompt redesign; unresolved jobs block affected class/source
annotations.unknown: excluded from positive states and from known-negative controls
annotations.disagreement: retain both independent versions; report agreement/unknown; no third-model majority substituted for truth
annotations.semantic_scope: native old/car truncation semantics are historical and differ; no claim of unified or corrected visual truth

selection.risk: equal_parts midpoint/uncertainty from frozen five-dimension config; quintiles from C_select only with sample-ID tie rule
selection.quotas: same class/Q/fine-cell quota vector for all three methods, largest remainder within Q; 40 selected per Q
selection.R: same-cell random initial200, shared by Greedy20/P20 at each start
selection.edits: at most20 original members removed; exact frozen Greedy and P20 implementations
selection.P20: historical support-first/occurrence-second formulation and finite-solver fallback; any execution adapter must reproduce historical fixtures before use
selection.original_numeric_thresholds: copied historical thresholds.json, no new-source recalibration
selection.selection_sources: A primary; B own-source predefined robustness, reported as a change of the whole risk/coverage/initialization bundle

endpoints.primary: per-class mean number of evaluable state predicates: state-positive and known same-field complement each >=20 distinct originals; macro-average six classes, then paired50 starts
endpoints.coverage_secondary: capped-support completion mean(min(n_state/20,1)), fixed state dictionary and denominator; plus occurrence/dual-pass
endpoints.label_evaluation: report A and B separately for fixed A selections; agreement-core separately. B own-source sets separately; no source pooling or best-source selection
endpoints.P20_vs_R_support_rule: positive primary macro mean difference under both A and B evaluators; report every class and label source even when mixed
endpoints.P20_vs_Greedy_rule: report primary/coverage difference together with runtime, solver statuses and constraint failures; no post-hoc minimal-useful-effect or universal superiority claim
endpoints.inference: one new image realization;50 starts share data and are not independent datasets. Report paired distributions/min/median/max and class-specific results; no significance claim from seeds as independent replicates

diagnosis.weights: 15 best.pt SHA bindings in checkpoint_lineage.csv; no retraining
diagnosis.preprocessing: each model's frozen run_recent_five_models.py/model.json inference transform; preserve historical input sizes/normalization
diagnosis.correctness: float mean of three seed-wise correct indicators, not majority-vote label
diagnosis.confirmed: same predicate weak on independent complete C_ref under same annotation source/classifier
diagnosis.main_comparison: intersection of evaluable state predicates for R/Greedy/P20 and C_ref, same universe for all method comparisons
diagnosis.additional: all-eligible counts with exact new/lost eligibility vs common-gap decomposition; raw selected error rates, Q gradients, runtime

sequence: automatic six-class smoke with frozen protocols; these targets remain in their frozen pools and cannot be tuned against
complete two-model annotation and freeze all labels/masks
compute risk and freeze R/Greedy/P20 selections without classifier outcomes
infer frozen15 checkpoints on both new pools
independent numerical audit and report all predefined endpoints
stop_rules: unresolved lineage/hash/near-duplicate failures block data qualification
annotation smoke may repair transport/schema formatting only; semantic changes require a new version and separate pilot, and invalidate this confirmatory run
no adaptive samples, thresholds, dictionaries, classifiers, seed subsets or label source after seeing outcomes
insufficient support is reported as unevaluable, never filled after predictions
failed or mixed outcomes are reported and bounded; no automatic relabeling/retry-until-positive
result_claim_status: no new empirical efficacy results; readiness/metadata only
